news.title: New Publication in Advanced Science
news.summary: We are excited to share a new publication in Advanced Science: Fixed-Linkage Enabled Ultra-Stable Ion Transport Channels in Membranes for Long-Life Alkaline Flow Batteries. The work shows how carefully engineered membrane channels can support more durable alkaline flow batteries.

news.title: New Publication in Advanced Energy Materials
news.summary: Our latest work in Advanced Energy Materials, Engineering Trace-Amount Electrolyte Additives for Aqueous Zinc Batteries, explores how tiny amounts of electrolyte additives can make a meaningful difference to zinc-battery performance.

news.title: New Publication in Science Advances
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our new perspective, Electrolyte Design for Aqueous Batteries, published in Science Advances. The article connects electrolyte chemistry, interfacial regulation, and practical aqueous-battery design.

news.title: Welcome to the Lab, Bowen Liang!
news.summary: Welcome Bowen Liang, who has joined our group as a Master's student! We are delighted to have him on board and look forward to his contributions to our research community.

news.title: Welcome to the Lab, Zhaoyang Zhang!
news.summary: A warm welcome to Zhaoyang Zhang, who has joined our group as a PhD student! We look forward to supporting his work on sustainable materials and water-related technologies.

news.title: Congratulations on Angewandte Chemie Acceptance
news.summary: Congratulations! The paper titled “Electron-Deficient Molecular Confinement Inhibiting Anion Hydrolysis for Stable Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries” by Mr. Li Zhaoxin has been accepted by Angewandte Chemie.

news.title: New Publication in Energy Materials and Devices
news.summary: We are excited to see The Transformative Potential of Cellulose in Energy Storage Systems published in Energy Materials and Devices. This work highlights cellulose as a versatile and sustainable platform for future energy technologies.

news.title: New Publication in Nano Letters
news.summary: Our study Zinc Powder Anodes for Rechargeable Aqueous Zinc-Based Batteries is now published in Nano Letters, offering a fresh look at zinc-powder architectures for rechargeable aqueous batteries.

news.title: New Publication in ACS Nano
news.summary: Now published in ACS Nano, Crystal Orientation Engineering of Perfectly Matched Heterogeneous Textured ZnSe for an Enhanced Interfacial Kinetic Zn Anode demonstrates how texture can unlock faster zinc-anode interfacial kinetics.

news.title: New Publication in Science Bulletin
news.summary: Our work in Science Bulletin, Distinct Chemistry between Zn and Li at Varied Temperature, reveals how temperature reshapes the chemistry of zinc and lithium systems.

news.title: New Publication in Small
news.summary: A new article in Small, Mechanistic Study of Interfacial Modification for Stable Zn Anode Based on a Thin Separator, shows how separator design can guide interfacial evolution and stabilize zinc cycling.

news.title: New Publication in Angewandte Chemie International Edition
news.summary: We are pleased to share our Angewandte Chemie International Edition publication on Dendrite Issues for Zinc Anodes in a Flexible Cell Configuration for Zinc-Based Wearable Energy-Storage Devices, bringing zinc-anode insights closer to flexible energy storage.

news.title: New Publication in Nature Communications
news.summary: Published in Nature Communications, Tailoring the Metal Electrode Morphology via Electrochemical Protocol Optimization for Long-Lasting Aqueous Zinc Batteries connects electrochemical protocols with longer-lasting zinc batteries.

news.title: New Publication in Joule
news.summary: Our Joule article, “Soft Shorts” Hidden in Zinc Metal Anode Research, calls attention to subtle short-circuit pathways that can change how aqueous zinc batteries are evaluated.

news.title: New Publication in Advanced Energy Materials
news.summary: We are pleased to highlight our Advanced Energy Materials study, Calendar Life of Zn Batteries Based on Zn Anode with Zn Powder/Current Collector Structure, which explores an architecture for extending zinc-battery lifetime.

news.title: New Publication in EcoMat
news.summary: In EcoMat, our review Dendrites Issues and Advances in Zn Anode for Aqueous Rechargeable Zn-Based Batteries maps the challenges and promising routes toward more reliable zinc anodes.

news.title: New Publication in Cellulose
news.summary: Our research on Engineering Cellulose Nanofibre Suspensions to Control Filtration Resistance and Sheet Permeability appeared in Cellulose, linking suspension engineering with tunable sheet performance.

news.title: New Publication in Journal of Materials Chemistry A
news.summary: A new paper in Journal of Materials Chemistry A, Cyclized-Polyacrylonitrile Modified Carbon Nanofiber Interlayers Enabling Strong Trapping of Polysulfides in Lithium-Sulfur Batteries, presents an interlayer strategy for stronger polysulfide control.
